(worth it) I still have issues where I have to have the game not running while playing Battlefield, bummer but oh well. I did Rebirth, and with it I have been wanting to play it less now, I feel like I saw everything, not sure if I have but I personally feel like something new come after rebirth, be it a new stat like crit or ability to regen or a new simple system like being able to evolve any of the weapons. For now I am still playing, but I am definitely less conflicted about closing the game if it is required for a game. Great game to stare at when I should be doing other things.

[h1]Easiest recommendation I’ve made all year.[/h1] If you enjoy idle games even a little, Desktop Defender is an instant yes. Boot it up, let your tiny little dude go absolutely feral on waves of enemies, level up when you remember to (lol), grab loot, push farther, bonk bosses, ascend, repeat. It nails that perfect “one more upgrade” loop without demanding your full attention. The best part? It lives in a tiny footprint on your screen, is fully movable/resizable, and sips system resources like it’s on a budget. You can work, game, browse, or just vibe while it runs in the corner, and the dev keeps optimizing it every update. The sound effects are punchy, the soundtrack goes surprisingly hard, and the price is honestly perfect for what you get. [h2]10/10. Again, easiest recommendation.[/h2]

Very surprised at how many positive reviews this got and how popular it became so quickly. Another shallow idle game with zero depth. There are 24 different weapons in total that you can unlock and as you progress, each one costs more yet they all do the same amount of damage and most of them you can't even differentiate, the 4th weapon you unlock in the game is somehow better than the next 20 weapons you unlock. To be more specific, the 4th weapon you can unlock called "bounce" is better than every weapon in the game other than the very last one, and the 17th unlockable one called "orbit." So basically, hit a wall, ascend, buy a weapon that is inferior to your previous weapon, repeat. That's all this game is. I'm starting to notice a weird trend where suddenly every idle game coming out has a price tag attached to it yet somehow the quality of those games is decreasing tremendously. This is the most linear and braindead idler slop I have seen, it's a massive waste of time and money. Just because it has a pretty coat of paint on it doesn't mean it's good. Please stop attaching price tags to this SLOP unless more effort is going to be put into it than the many free idlers that already exist and continue to come out.

I'll have to leave a negative review. The game isn't bad but it's very linear and for a lot of parts it feels like a glorified screen saver. It does have mechanics like loot, weapons, levels, prestige/ascension that would hint it's an actual game but in reality you can just leave it running and go buy what ever random you like every now and then and win. The waves are always the same. First 4 waves of trash of a few kinds of enemies that might be faster, slower, bouncier or what ever and then a boss that rushes straight toward at you. There's no real strategy, just have more dps. If you want to optimize switch to a higher single target dps weapon when the boss comes but that's it. The only thing that I can think of that needs some thinking is figuring out which items you equip and for which weapon. After that just leave the game running, come check the game once in a while to level up and buy skills and ascend. Even the skills and levels are very linear. Basically more dps or more currency (money, exp, prestige). Someone might enjoy this but for me it's so predictable that it's boring. I don't like games that play like screen savers. For the price it's a reasonable buy but personally I'd rather buy one of those idle games with just one goal and no ascension. You get the same amount of gameplay time out of them and those games keep feeding you new and interesting stuff all the way to the end. If you look at other genres I don't think 5€ is good value for this. Personally 5€ is such a small amount of money that I don't care but for someone that has to think more carefully what to buy I definitely would recommend something else.

At first glance, the game seems like a simple but addictive grind, with lots of upgrades, weapons to try, and multiple prestige layers meant to keep you playing. The early hours are fine and it does a decent job of giving you that constant sense of progress. But it doesn’t take very long before the cracks start to show, and what initially feels flexible and engaging turns into a very rigid experience where only a few choices actually matter. [h3]--- Progression and Upgrades ---[/h3] Starts ok, but quickly become a thing you check on every few hours. Like others have said, there's no real strategy, at some point HP is just a useless stat because everything kills you in one hit. Just dump everything into fire rate, damage and XP, and you'll be farming your way to level 150 fairly quickly. [h3]--- Loot System ---[/h3] Loot system is kinda bad. Some of the stats don't seem to have any effect. I got some +% Projectile Damage items that didn't change the damage at all, but the small +Flat Damage items changed the damage massively. Things like projectile speed and size are completely useless. The only things that matter again are items with +% XP and the flat damage ones. Having a single +25% fire rate made the shooting speed stupidly high when fire rate upgrade is maxed. [h3]--- Weapons ---[/h3] Weapons, while interesting to experiment with, only a handful are actually good, and some are functionally identical. Radius or Cogs are good, shooting all around you, which kills everything up to floor 40, but then don't have enough output to deal with anything. That's when I switched to lightning and it's insane knockback which got me all the way to floor 65. But then knockback doesn't work on bosses, so that's the furthest I got. [h3]--- Prestige Layer 1 ---[/h3] Ascension is fine at first, but then becomes just a multiplier to XP and Money. The currency you get also let's you buy 3 upgrades, 2 of which are capped and you quickly reach that, the third is a +1 flat damage for every upgrade. You also buy the weapons with that currency, but those are very cheap, so it doesn't feel like progression. [h3]--- Prestige Layer 2 ---[/h3] Looking at the Rebirth confirmation screen is what made me lose all interest in the game. You lose all your past progress, including levels and ascension, and all you gain is a 25% boost to XP and Money. That's it, no extra currency with interesting upgrades, no special weapons, just a tiny boost to XP and Money. That's a no for me. [h3]--- Achievements ---[/h3] Achievements are mostly related to killing enemies with each weapon. 10000 enemies to be specific. That's a huge chore, because like I said, most weapons are bad. And you can't control which floor you're on, so you're always fighting stronger and stronger enemies. There's also a 100 hours played achievement that is just silly. I got through to prestige layer 2 in just 36 hours before losing interest in the game. Other achievements are related to progress and buying weapons, so nothing interesting.

This game saved my life. I am 39. My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and adopted our son together. They are now both 4 years old. When we were going through our separation, I found myself lost and miserable. I was self destructive. I got so mad one day from everything spiraling out of my control that I punched some concrete in a moment of overwhelming emotion. That caused me to break my 5th metacarpal in my right hand... my working hand... my games hand.. the hand that I held and carried my children to bed with.. The hand I desperately needed to make sure I could continue to provide. After learning of the severity of my self-inflicted damage, I was borderline suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man with no history of depression or anxiety. I have never had fits of rage, or been one to break down and cry, but I was in a low spot that just really buried me from being able to see the light on the other side. Having nothing better to do, I searched for a game I could play, ONE HANDED while I recovered. I somehow stumbled upon this game and read some of the reviews. I decided that it had to be worth a shot... I must admit, I didn't beat the game, or play nearly as long as some of you. In fact, I may have only played this game a day or two.. With that being said, after doing so, I had a new found joy and hope for life. I was able to put behind me the pain and suffering that had been cast over me. I was able to experience other peoples joy and happiness. I was able to see the fruits of my "labor". I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ing minutes to this music long enough to realize that I was going to be okay. After coming to that realization, I turned the game off, and I went back to work. It hurt my hand like hell but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so damn sorry for myself, and I became the father I needed to be in that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving as. Today, I am close friend with my kids mother. We don't fight, or argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents, and friends. I now have 3 kids. My third child is, wait for it, ALSO 5 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my own separation, and we just stumbled in to each others life unexpectedly. We have been in a relationship for a year now, and are very happy together. Moral of the story, you never know what life holds in store for you, and if I would have given up when all the odds were stacked against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Warning for neurodivergent individuals, this game is not NEARLY idle enough. If you're like me, you'll have a bit of fun with this game early on but over time will realize it's a time-vampire that you'll want to micromanage too often. Inb4 the funny jokes about leaving a negative review on a game I have 250 hours in, it's an idle game, that's how it works. After a long time of playing it and gauging my enjoyment and satisfaction, I've found that I'm just waiting to do the next action so that I can wait a little more to do the next one, and in these moments I just feel frustration and a growing sense of wasting my time. When these games are made well, it's a satisfying side-project to spend a few clicks on, a few times a day. When made... like this game... it's a tedious vampire that would prefer you sink 10+ actions in to it every 5 minutes or so. Oh yeah, and after getting around the mid-game point, lag becomes a major player... especially if you're taking loot that increases shot count (AKA, for where I was at least, objectively, the most powerful loot option to choose.) I had graphics lowered to the minimum and it was very uncomfortable to play... "play" TL;DR: Game is way too active, it's an idle game that saps a looooot of your time. There's a "turbo mode" that is "not recommended as the intended experience" because it makes the game "too active" but... I never activated turbo mode, the game is simply too active as it is. A TIME-VAMPIRE FOR NEURODIVERGENT FOLKS RUN AWAY SAVE YOURSELF

This game is so peak, I'm writing my review while it's on. Real talk. It is a good game, fun to have in the background for fun, and the minimum requirement is basically ignorable. Whether you're putting it on while doing work, or you're playing another game, it's fun. I have ADHD and this gives me a tiny little thing to look at, sometimes it's fun to just focus on it. It also solves all the issues I personally have with tower defense games, and that's that they're boring as hell especially when they're meant to be the full focus. But, this doesn't ask for your full attention, maybe a couple clicks which are optional if you wanna change sizes or just upgrade your triangle. And the minimum requirement is literally 1 gb of ram, which, IN THIS ECONOMY???? Nah, but it's good for what it is, if you're looking for anything more than something to have in the background or that you want to put all your attention into, this isn't what you're looking for. But, if you're looking for a fun thing to have in the background to help with the the world's dwindling attention span that has the collective power of a goldfish with Alzheimer's, this is for you. Enjoy. TL;DR: Cheap, fun to play in background, doesn't tank performance at all

It's got some neat ideas, but I feel it doesn't execute particularly well on what it's doing. While the concept of a docked idle game for the corner of your screen is cool, it's not a completely novel idea. The mechanics seem to not completely know if it is an idle game or a tower defense game, with the progression feeling stilted while waiting for "loot" to drop which can be relatively attention demanding as you play with builds or the upgrades which don't increase in price at a consistent rate as well as having some that are extremely powerful while others do hardly anything. The UI is confusing, I still can't easily remember which tab is Weapons vs Armory vs Loot vs Upgrades and always click the wrong things. The games not bad, but it's not quite at what I would consider $5 of value. Smoothing the experience could easily flip this for me but for now it's not recommended.

This game has so many issues. The only difference between projectile damage and shot damage is that shot damage will actually increase your damage. The game lacks descriptions on how things actually work i.e. what determines how much ascendium you gain (is it time based? XP based? round based? kill based?). Increased projectile numbers just don't work with the weapon cogs. Speaking of cogs, the "piercing projectile" has a limit to how much it can pierce, and to my knowledge there is no way of increasing it. The extra bullets upgrade is described as increasing the likelihood of shooting extra bullets, but it outright just increases the amount you fire. Opening up the level menu always opens it 20 levels above from where I am and I have to scroll up by a margin big enough to constantly annoy me. Certain weapons are straight up useless, blue hole is actual garbage. In regards of extra projectiles, it is inconsistent on how it works. Weapons like bit, blue hole, and radius only increase the amount you're shooting by one projectile per increase (pretty standard right?). BUT weapons like burst, and I think flamethrower, increase the weapon's barrage. So tell me, why does burst get two barrages, 6 projectiles compared to the original 3, and radius only gets 1 extra projectile, instead of 5 extra. Actually, one more thing. Weapons that suffer from inaccuracy, such as burst, aren't listed as being inaccurate and can't become more accurate with loot that decreases the cone that you fire in. So if you have loot that decreases your cone without having an "actual" cone, it'll just end up making a cone for you, since the loot uses flat degree values. Edit: A lot of things have been fixed, projectile damage actually does something now. Loot that was focused around having better aim have been changed from reducing your firing cone to increasing your accuracy. The levels tab saves where it was located after you close it. It seems there will be another update to bring even more fixes. However, there are still problems in my review that are either not fixed or I haven't noticed to be fixed. I will wait until the update before I officially change my review

总的来说，可以玩，但系统不是很丰富，奇奇怪怪的地方也不少。 战利品 基本上是整个游戏的核心，中后期稀有的战利品是我的主要动力来源。 公告说在四五月份战利品会有大更新，可以稍微等一等再玩。 当前版本问题还蛮多的： 1.非常不平衡，像加999点血量，对于随随便便就几万几十万的后期血量来说，完全没用。 2.属性加成的计算很奇怪，射速2.3发/秒的时候，拿个射速+25%的战利品就变成10发/秒了。还有投射物伤害-95%，不管是前期还是后期，都完全没有效果。 3.后期会需要刷稀有战利品，但是掉落上限只有8个，需要经常出售，也没有自动分解低级战利品之类的功能，好麻烦。 26.03.19：今天的更新里，战利品重做了！前两条都大改了！ 升级 这部分我主要想讲讲它的数值曲线，虽然对于游戏流程来说没什么影响，但让我觉得有点点别扭。 首先升级的费用增长，它的曲线前期陡后期平，以金钱增长的升级为例，1级时升级一次消耗10，100级时消耗3.62M；30000级升级一次消耗13.82T，35000级升级一次69.65T。后期的等级基本上是成倍增加的。 其次是升级的效果。还是以金钱增长的升级为例，1级时加49%，而287到300级都只加0%，301级又加49%（并不是说边际效用，而是每级增加的净数值）。这样子每300级一个周期（不同的升级，周期不同）。 虽然有快捷键能一下子花一半的钱或者全部的钱购买升级，但为什么不能索性让价格和升级效果的曲线都平滑一点呢？ 转生和重生（大转生） 转生系统，容量和额外子弹一共就只能升级10次，升完就只能全点伤害了。 一周目的时候，还可以买武器，换着玩还挺新鲜的，但是重生一次之后，就完全没有新鲜感了。 重生系统，我重生了六次，每次要求的目标波次只是从90波，龟速涨到了92波。而且就算多打几波，重生也没有额外奖励。 也许游戏制作者的思路是希望玩家围绕前中期进行构筑，然后快速重生？ 而且重生也只是给了一些加成，完全没有新内容，也没有难度增幅。最后一次重生我只花了半天多一点就打到了100多波（没开快速模式），我觉得我完全没有动力去重复这个流程（不过也没有成就，所以还好）。 噢对了，虽然界面里说，重生完全不会保留任何东西，其实会保留战利品（不过刚重生，战利品容量还是和最开始一样只有两个，超出的那些会暂时无效）。这也是为什么我说战利品是这个游戏的核心。 综合下来，进步空间还蛮大的，尤其是重生系统，感觉只是个半成品。 成就方面，除了游玩时长的成就外，差不多会在50小时左右完成，这部分也是玩得比较开心的时期。后面50小时只是为了拿100小时成就，才顺便打了一下重生。 另外，右下角箭头，设置，后期处理 0%，可以关掉鱼眼效果。

You can realistically complete all the steam achievements in about 20 hours except for the "online for 50hr" and "online for 100hr". That being said, there are other rebirth-related achievements in-game (but not in steam) that can help keep you occupied between hour 21 to 100. So it's not too bad, I guess.
